title: G45 Profile Request Trigger Analysis
methodology: IDA disassembly + live game log analysis + public reference comparison

trigger_chain.description: /player/profile/load is triggered by the NESYS card event flow (ReadCard), not by any server-side endpoint or game state flag directly.
steps: 1. NESYS card physically inserted into card reader
2. NESYS pipe connection established (requires cert3.nesys.jp trust)
3. bNesicaReception flag set to 1 by game's NESYS handler
4. Game transitions from InsertStart → ReadCard state
5. CPP_ReadCardMain reads card data via NESYS pipe
6. Game extracts nesys_id from card data
9. Game stores profile and transitions to main menu

insertstart_to_readcard_conditions.description: The transition from InsertStart widget to ReadCard requires:
conditions: Credits > 0 (coin inserted or free play enabled)
NESYS card reader reports card present
insertstart_to_readcard_conditions.evidence: IDA analysis of CPP_InsertStartWidget.cpp at RVA 0x147B9B7E0
insertstart_to_readcard_conditions.current_status: Game loops at InsertStart because IsOnline=0 (NESYS cert not trusted)

starwingparadox.parity: Field names match, handler structure matches

current_blocker.description: The game cannot reach /player/profile/load because the NESYS card event (ReadCard flow) never initiates. This requires NESYS certificate trust, which we cannot provide without compromising the game binary or connecting to the real NESYS infrastructure.
current_blocker.seven_flag_status: 5 of 7 flags pass. bNesysServerLive[0] and bNesicaReception[0] block the gate.
current_blocker.no_safe_bypass: Cannot force bNesicaReception without NESYS cert trust. Cannot patch the gate. Cannot implement cert.
